description: This file is a markdown document describing the Composite Input HAL Interface for a media platform. It includes detailed specifications, design considerations, APIs, capabilities, workflows, and implementation guidelines for the composite video input hardware abstraction layer.

classes.name: compositeinput
classes.description: Main namespace/package containing the AIDL interfaces and data structures for the Composite Input HAL.

methods.name: getPlatformCapabilities
methods.description: Returns the platform-wide capabilities, including supported features and port configurations.

methods.name: getPortIds
methods.description: Retrieves the list of available composite input port IDs.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the interface for a specific port given its ID.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves capabilities of a specific port, including supported properties and metrics.

methods.name: getPortInfo
methods.description: Provides metadata such as name and description for a port.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Queries a specific property from the port, returning its current value.

methods.name: getPropertyMulti
methods.description: Batch queries multiple properties for efficiency.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves telemetry metrics for ports that support metrics.

methods.name: registerTelemetryListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for periodic telemetry updates on a port that supports metrics.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a port for video presentation, only if signal is stable.
